_original_lore: The Minotaur is a rare mob in the Mythological
Ritual. It will attack at melee range, and can
throw an axe at you, temporarily slowing down
your healing speed. It has a special mechanic
called Bleed that allows it to do more damage.
It increases by 1 every time it hits you, and
increases by 3 every time its axe hits you.
name: 弥诺陶洛斯 (神话生物)

source: The Minotaur is a rare mob in the Mythological
Ritual. It will attack at melee range, and can
throw an axe at you, temporarily slowing down
your healing speed. It has a special mechanic
called Bleed that allows it to do more damage.
loreParagraphs.translation: 弥诺陶洛斯是神话仪式中的稀有怪物.它会进行近战攻击,并能向你投掷斧头,暂时降低你的治疗速度.它有一个名为流血的特殊机制,使其能造成更多伤害.

source: It increases by {{N0}} every time it hits you, and
increases by {{N1}} every time its axe hits you.
loreParagraphs.translation: 它每次击中你都会提升 {{N0}},其斧头每次击中你都会提升 {{N1}}.
怪物类型: ✿ 神话, ✰ 人形
